notes:
I don't have any notes on Jeremiah 51:22–43 for you yet. The research didn't finish.

I tried to read six pages: the Enduring Word commentary on Jeremiah 51 and the Bible Hub commentary pages for verses 25, 27, 34, 39 and 41. My code failed while reading the downloaded pages. When I tried to fix it, the tool said I had used up my calls for this turn, so I never saw any of their content.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written anything I couldn't check against a source, and there are no verse notes, tradition comparisons or other-view entries to give you yet.

If you reply (even just "continue"), I'll start over in a fresh turn and work through:
1. **Traditional reading:** Enduring Word, plus Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub or StudyLight for each verse, and Precept Austin.
2. **Differences between traditions:** searches on Ligonier, Monergism, The Gospel Coalition, Desiring God, Grace to You, Spurgeon, Wesley (wesley.nnu.edu), Seedbed and the LCMS for the themes these verses raise.
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes, Bible Odyssey, New Advent and catholic.com, only where the sites actually discuss this passage.

You'll then get verse-by-verse notes ("v. 22: …"), with a URL after each point and anything I couldn't find left out.
